Paddy.name: Rice Blast Disease
Paddy.symptoms: Spindle-shaped or diamond-shaped lesions with ash-grey or white centers and brown margins on leaves.
Paddy.treatment_chemical: Spray Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 0.6 g/L or Isoprothiolane 40 EC @ 1.5 ml/L or Kasugamycin 3% SL @ 2.5 ml/L at initial appearance of spots.
Paddy.treatment_organic: Spray Pseudomonas fluorescens (biocontrol agent) @ 5 g/L or 10 g/kg seed treatment.

Paddy.name: Brown Spot Disease
Paddy.symptoms: Small, oval or circular brown spots with dark brown margins and greyish centers on leaves and glumes.
Paddy.treatment_chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L or Propiconazole 25 EC @ 1 ml/L or Hexaconazole 5 EC @ 2 ml/L during boot leaf stage..
Paddy.treatment_organic: Foliar spray of 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or Panchagavya (3%).

Ragi.name: Finger Millet Blast (Leaf & Neck Blast)
Ragi.name_kn: ರಾಗಿ ಬೆಂಕಿ ರೋಗ (ಎಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕುತ್ತಿಗೆ ಬ್ಲಾಸ್ಟ್)
Ragi.symptoms: Spindle-shaped spots on leaves. The most destructive phase is neck blast where the stem below the earhead turns black, causing the earhead to break or produce chaffy, empty grains..
Ragi.treatment_chemical: Spray Kitazin 48 EC @ 2 ml/L or Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 0.6 g/L or Saaf (Carbendazim + Mancozeb) @ 2 g/L at earhead emergence..
Ragi.treatment_organic: Treat seeds with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/kg seed.

Ragi.name: Foot Rot & Seedling Blight
Ragi.symptoms: Brown discoloration of collar region of young seedlings, followed by wilting and drying up.
Ragi.treatment_chemical: Drench soil with Captan 50 WP @ 3 g/L or Carbendazim 50 WP @ 1 g/L around affected patches..
Ragi.treatment_organic: Apply Trichoderma viride enriched FYM (2 kg Trichoderma in 100 kg compost) to the furrow at sowing..

Maize.name: Turcicum Leaf Blight (TLB)
Maize.symptoms: Long, elliptical, grayish-green or tan lesions (up to 15 cm long) appear on leaves starting from bottom leaves and moving upwards, giving a burnt appearance..
Maize.treatment_chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L or Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1 ml/L at first appearance of spots..
Maize.treatment_organic: Foliar spray of 5% Neem oil or Trichoderma harzianum @ 5 g/L at knee-high stage..

Maize.name: Fall Armyworm (FAW) Infestation
Maize.symptoms: Extensive pin-hole damage on young leaves, window paning, followed by heavy feeding inside the central whorl with prominent sawdust-like moist fecal pellets..
Maize.treatment_chemical: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 0.4 ml/L or Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG @ 0.4 g/L directed into the central leaf whorl..
Maize.treatment_organic: Apply sand + wood ash mixture (9:1) or Metarhizium rileyi / Beauveria bassiana @ 5 g/L into whorls.

Sugarcane.name: Red Rot Disease
Sugarcane.symptoms: Yellowing and drying of crown leaves. Canes split open longitudinally show red pith tissue with characteristic transverse white patches and an alcoholic sour smell..
Sugarcane.treatment_chemical: Drench field with Carbendazim 50 WP @ 1 g/L.
Sugarcane.treatment_organic: Sett dip treatment in Trichoderma viride culture suspension (10 g/L water) for 15 minutes before planting..

Sugarcane.name: Smut Disease (Chabuk)
Sugarcane.symptoms: Production of a prominent whip-like, curved, pencil-thick black structure from the central shoot spindle covered by a silver membrane releasing millions of sooty spores..
Sugarcane.treatment_chemical: Dip setts in Carbendazim 50 WP (1 g/L) or Triadimefon (1 g/L) solution for 15 minutes prior to furrow planting..
Sugarcane.treatment_organic: Hot water sett treatment at 50°C for 2 hours with bio-inoculants..

Cotton.name: Bacterial Blight / Angular Leaf Spot
Cotton.symptoms: Angular water-soaked spots bounded by veins on leaves turning dark brown/black.
Cotton.treatment_chemical: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50 WP @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L (1 g in 10 L water).
Cotton.treatment_organic: Spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) + Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L..

Cotton.name: Leaf Reddening & Magnesium Deficiency
Cotton.symptoms: Interveinal areas of mature leaves turn purplish-red while veins stay green.
Cotton.treatment_chemical: Foliar spray of Magnesium Sulphate (MgSO4) @ 10 g/L (1%) + Urea @ 10 g/L (1%) during peak flowering and boll formation..
Cotton.treatment_organic: Apply 25 kg Magnesium Sulphate/acre as soil application along with FYM during earthing up..

Tomato.name: Early Blight & Target Spot
Tomato.symptoms: Dark brown to black necrotic spots with characteristic concentric rings (target board effect) surrounded by yellow chlorotic halos, causing defoliation..
Tomato.treatment_chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L or Azoxystrobin 23 SC @ 1 ml/L or Chlorothalonil 75 WP @ 2 g/L..
Tomato.treatment_organic: Spray Neem oil 3 ml/L + soap solution or Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/L.

Tomato.name: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV)
Tomato.symptoms: Upward and downward curling, puckering, and crinkling of leaves with thickened veins.
Tomato.treatment_chemical: Vector control: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.3 ml/L or Diafenthiuron 50 WP @ 1.2 g/L or Acetamiprid 20 SP @ 0.3 g/L..

Chilli.name: Anthracnose / Fruit Rot / Die-Back
Chilli.name_kn: ಮೆಣಸಿನಕಾಯಿ ಕಾಯಿ ಕೊಳೆ & ಕೊಂಬೆ ಒಣಗು ರೋಗ
Chilli.symptoms: Circular sunken lesions on ripe red fruits with black concentric rings of fungal fruiting bodies.
Chilli.treatment_chemical: Spray Azoxystrobin 23 SC @ 1 ml/L or Difenoconazole 25 EC @ 0.5 ml/L or Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L at fruit setting..

Chilli.name: Chilli Murda Complex (Leaf Curl / Thrips & Mites)
Chilli.name_hi: Chilli Murda Complex (Leaf Curl / Thrips & Mites)
Chilli.symptoms: Leaves curl upward into a boat-shape with bronze underside (thrips) or curl downward inverted-cup shape with brittle foliage (mites)..
Chilli.treatment_organic: Spray 5% NSKE or Pongamia / Neem oil (5 ml/L).

Banana.name: Sigatoka Leaf Spot (Yellow & Black)
Banana.symptoms: Small yellowish spots parallel to veins on older leaves that enlarge into spindle-shaped brown patches with grey centers and yellow halos, leading to leaf scorching..
Banana.treatment_chemical: Spray Propiconazole 25 EC @ 1 ml/L or Carbendazim 50 WP @ 1 g/L with mineral oil (10 ml/L) or Azoxystrobin @ 1 ml/L..
Banana.treatment_organic: Foliar spray of 1% Bordeaux mixture or Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L with surfactant..

Banana.name: Panama Wilt (Fusarium Wilt)
Banana.symptoms: Yellowing of lower leaf margins progressing inward, followed by petiole collapse forming a skirt of dead hanging leaves.
Banana.treatment_chemical: Drench soil around plants with Carbendazim 50 WP (2 g/L).
Banana.treatment_organic: Apply 500g Neem cake + 25g Trichoderma viride per pit during planting.

Arecanut.name: Koleroga / Fruit Rot (Mahali)
Arecanut.symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions on tender green nuts during South-West Monsoon.
Arecanut.treatment_chemical: Spray 1% Bordeaux Mixture or Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L prophylactically before onset of monsoon rains..
Arecanut.treatment_organic: Tie polythene covers over arecanut bunches before monsoon onset to prevent rain splash infection..

Arecanut.name: Yellow Leaf Disease (YLD)
Arecanut.symptoms: Bright yellowing of inner whorl leaves spreading to crown, root necrosis, reduced nut size with blackened, spongy kernels..
Arecanut.treatment_chemical: Vector control: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.3 ml/L or Dimethoate @ 1.5 ml/L.
Arecanut.treatment_organic: Apply 10 kg compost + 2 kg neem cake + bio-fertilizers per palm annually..

Groundnut.name: Tikka Leaf Spot (Early & Late Blight)
Groundnut.symptoms: Circular reddish-brown to dark spots on leaves with distinct yellow halos (Early Tikka) or circular black spots on underside of leaves without halos (Late Tikka)..
Groundnut.treatment_chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2 g/L or Hexaconazole 5 EC @ 2 ml/L or Tebuconazole 25.9 EC @ 1 ml/L at 40 and 60 days after sowing..
Groundnut.treatment_organic: Spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L..

Groundnut.name: Collar Rot / Crown Rot
Groundnut.symptoms: Black sooty fungal spores at the collar region near soil line.
Groundnut.treatment_chemical: Seed treatment with Thiram 3 g/kg or Carbendazim 2 g/kg.
Groundnut.treatment_organic: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/kg seed + soil application of 2.5 kg Trichoderma enriched in 500 kg FYM..

Onion.name: Purple Blotch of Onion
Onion.symptoms: Small, sunken, water-soaked lesions that develop a purple-to-dark brown center with concentric rings.
Onion.treatment_chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L or Difenoconazole 25 EC @ 1 ml/L or Propiconazole @ 1 ml/L mixed with Sandovit sticker (0.5 ml/L)..
Onion.treatment_organic: Foliar spray of 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or Trichoderma harzianum @ 5 g/L.

Onion.name: Basal Rot / Bulb Rot
Onion.symptoms: Yellowing and dying back of leaves from tips downwards.
Onion.treatment_chemical: Soil drenching with Copper Oxychloride 50 WP @ 3 g/L or Carbendazim 50 WP @ 1 g/L around affected plant base..
Onion.treatment_organic: Soil application of Trichoderma viride enriched Farm Yard Manure (FYM) @ 5 kg/acre mixed in 2 tonnes compost..

Pomegranate.name: Bacterial Blight / Telya (Black Spot)
Pomegranate.symptoms: Dark brown to black water-soaked angular spots on leaves.
Pomegranate.treatment_chemical: Spray Streptocycline @ 0.5 g/L + Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5 g/L or Bordeaux Mixture (1%).

Pomegranate.name: Cercospora Fruit & Leaf Spot
Pomegranate.symptoms: Minute blackish circular spots on leaves and fruit rinds that coalesce into large necrotic patches, rendering fruit unmarketable..
Pomegranate.treatment_chemical: Spray Difenoconazole 25 EC @ 1 ml/L or Chlorothalonil 75 WP @ 2 g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1 ml/L..
Pomegranate.treatment_organic: Foliar application of Neem oil @ 5 ml/L + potassium soap.

Grapes.name: Downy Mildew of Grapes
Grapes.symptoms: Yellowish translucent oily spots (oilspots) on upper leaf surface.
Grapes.treatment_chemical: Spray Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Dimethomorph 50 WP @ 1 g/L or Cymoxanil + Mancozeb @ 2 g/L..
Grapes.treatment_organic: Foliar spray of Trichoderma harzianum @ 5 g/L or Potassium Phosphite (3 g/L) to induce systemic acquired resistance..

Grapes.name: Powdery Mildew of Grapes
Grapes.symptoms: White powdery powdery patches covering leaves, green shoots, and berries.
Grapes.treatment_chemical: Spray Wettable Sulphur 80 WP @ 2.5 g/L or Penconazole 10 EC @ 0.5 ml/L or Myclobutanil @ 0.4 g/L..
Grapes.treatment_organic: Spray 10% unpasteurized cow milk solution in water or Neem oil 3 ml/L + baking soda (sodium bicarbonate 2 g/L)..

Coffee.name: Coffee Leaf Rust (CLR)
Coffee.symptoms: Characteristic orange-yellow powdery pustules on the lower surface of leaves.
Coffee.treatment_chemical: Spray Bordeaux Mixture (0.5%) before pre-monsoon (May) and post-monsoon (October).
Coffee.treatment_organic: Foliar spray of Beauveria bassiana or Verticillium hemileiae biocontrol formulations.

Coffee.name: Black Rot / Koleroga of Coffee
Coffee.symptoms: Blackening and rotting of leaves and developing green berries.
Coffee.treatment_chemical: Spray 1% Bordeaux Mixture just before onset of southwest monsoon.

Coconut.name: Bud Rot of Coconut
Coconut.symptoms: Central shoot or spindle leaf withers, turns yellowish-brown and rots completely.
Coconut.treatment_chemical: Remove all rotting tissues from crown and apply Bordeaux Paste (10%) or Metalaxyl-Mancozeb sachet (3g) placed in crown.
Coconut.treatment_organic: Place perforated polythene sachet containing 5g Trichoderma harzianum talc formulation in leaf axils adjacent to central spindle..

Coconut.name: Stem Bleeding Disease
Coconut.symptoms: Exudation of dark reddish-brown gummy liquid from cracks in stem trunk 2-3 meters from ground level.
Coconut.treatment_chemical: Chisel out infected bark with chisel.
Coconut.treatment_organic: Root feeding with 5% Neem oil formulation or apply 5 kg Neem cake per palm annually..

Red gram (Tur).name: Fusarium Wilt of Pigeon Pea
Red gram (Tur).symptoms: Gradual drooping and wilting of plants, starting on one side of plant.
Red gram (Tur).treatment_organic: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 5g/kg + Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5g/kg.

Red gram (Tur).name: Sterility Mosaic Disease (SMD)
Red gram (Tur).symptoms: Bushy, stunted vegetative growth with light green/yellow mosaic mottling on leaves.
Red gram (Tur).treatment_chemical: Spray Fenazaquin 10 EC @ 1 ml/L or Propargite 57 EC @ 2 ml/L or Wettable Sulphur @ 3 g/L to control the vector mite..
Red gram (Tur).treatment_organic: Spray Neem oil 5 ml/L mixed with soap nut solution at 30 and 45 days after sowing..

Jowar.name: Grain Mold / Head Mold
Jowar.symptoms: Pink, black, or chalky white fungal growth over developing grains during rainy harvest periods.
Jowar.treatment_chemical: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 1 ml/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L at 50% flowering stage..
Jowar.treatment_organic: Spray Pseudomonas fluorescens (1%) or 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) at panicle emergence..

Jowar.name: Anthracnose and Leaf Blight
Jowar.name_hi: ज्वार का एंथ्रेक्नोज व अंगमारी रोग
Jowar.symptoms: Small circular reddish-purple spots on leaves that elongate into large dead blights.
Jowar.treatment_chemical: Foliar spray with Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1 g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1 ml/L..
Jowar.treatment_organic: Foliar spray of Trichoderma harzianum @ 5 g/L with 2% cow urine extract..

Bajra.name: Downy Mildew / Green Ear Disease
Bajra.name_kn: ಹಸಿರು ತೆನೆ ರೋಗ / ಬೆಳ್ಳಿ ಎಲೆ ರೋಗ
Bajra.name_hi: बाजरे का हरित बाली व तुलासिता रोग
Bajra.symptoms: Floral parts of the ear head transform into leafy structures resembling a green brush.
Bajra.treatment_chemical: Foliar spray with Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil MZ 72 WP) @ 2 g/L at 21 days after sowing..
Bajra.treatment_organic: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/kg followed by foliar spray at 30 days..

Bajra.name: Ergot of Bajra
Bajra.symptoms: Pinkish honey-like viscous fluid oozes from infected spikelets, later drying into dark hard sclerotial horns..
Bajra.treatment_chemical: Foliar spray of Mancozeb @ 2 g/L or Ziram @ 2 g/L at boot-leaf and 50% flowering stage..
Bajra.treatment_organic: Dip seeds in 10% common salt solution to float off and discard sclerotia prior to sowing..

Wheat.name: Brown / Leaf Rust
Wheat.symptoms: Bright orange-brown pustules scattered randomly on the upper leaf surface.
Wheat.treatment_chemical: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 1 ml/L or Tebuconazole @ 1 ml/L at the first appearance of pustules..
Wheat.treatment_organic: Foliar spray with sour buttermilk (5%) or Neem oil (3 ml/L) with emulsifier..

Wheat.name: Spot Blotch / Leaf Blight
Wheat.symptoms: Small elongated brown lesions on lower leaves expanding with yellow chlorotic margins into irregular blights..
Wheat.treatment_chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1 ml/L during tillering and heading..
Wheat.treatment_organic: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 4 g/kg + foliar spray of Pseudomonas @ 5 g/L..

Foxtail millet (Navane).name: Blast Disease (Navane Blast)
Foxtail millet (Navane).symptoms: Diamond or spindle-shaped lesions with ash-grey centers and brown borders on leaves and necks of panicles..
Foxtail millet (Navane).treatment_chemical: Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP (Baan) @ 0.6 g/L or Isoprothiolane @ 1.5 ml/L..
Foxtail millet (Navane).treatment_organic: Foliar spray of 10% cow urine extract + 5% Neem leaf extract..

Foxtail millet (Navane).name: Head Smut of Foxtail Millet
Foxtail millet (Navane).symptoms: Individual grains in the spikelet are replaced by black powdery masses of smut spores covered by a delicate membrane..
Foxtail millet (Navane).treatment_chemical: Seed treatment with Carboxin 37.5% + Thiram 37.5% (Vitavax Power) @ 2 g/kg seed..
Foxtail millet (Navane).treatment_organic: Hot water seed treatment at 54°C for 10 minutes prior to sowing..

Bengal gram.name: Fusarium Wilt of Chickpea
Bengal gram.symptoms: Drooping of petioles, yellowing and drying of foliage starting from lower leaves.
Bengal gram.treatment_chemical: Seed treatment with Carbendazim + Mancozeb (Saaf) @ 2 g/kg.
Bengal gram.treatment_organic: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/kg + soil incorporation of 2.5 kg Trichoderma mixed in 250 kg FYM/acre..

Bengal gram.name: Ascochyta Blight
Bengal gram.symptoms: Circular brown spots on leaflets and pods with concentric rings of dark pycnidia.
Bengal gram.treatment_chemical: Foliar spray with Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1 ml/L..
Bengal gram.treatment_organic: Foliar spray of 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) at early symptom appearance..

Green gram.name: Mungbean Yellow Mosaic Virus (MYMV)
Green gram.name_hi: मूंग का पीला मोज़ेक वायरस रोग
Green gram.symptoms: Irregular bright yellow and green patches on young leaves.
Green gram.treatment_chemical: Control whitefly vector by spraying Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.25 g/L or Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.7 ml/L..

Green gram.name: Cercospora Leaf Spot
Green gram.symptoms: Circular to angular brown spots with grayish centers on leaves.
Green gram.treatment_chemical: Foliar spray of Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1 g/L or Mancozeb @ 2 g/L at first appearance of spots..
Green gram.treatment_organic: Foliar spray with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L..

Black gram.name: Yellow Mosaic Disease (YMV)
Black gram.symptoms: Scattered yellow specks coalescing into large bright golden patches on foliage.
Black gram.treatment_chemical: Seed treatment with Imidacloprid 600 FS @ 5 ml/kg.
Black gram.treatment_organic: Erect 20 yellow sticky traps per acre.

Black gram.name: Powdery Mildew of Black Gram
Black gram.symptoms: White flour-like powdery patches on upper leaf surface, stems and pods.
Black gram.treatment_chemical: Spray Wettable Sulphur 80% WP @ 3 g/L or Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 1 ml/L..
Black gram.treatment_organic: Foliar spray with cow urine (10%) or wettable sulfur bio-formulations..

Horse gram.name: Dry Root Rot / Charcoal Rot
Horse gram.name_hi: कुलथी का सूखा जड़ सड़न रोग
Horse gram.symptoms: Sudden wilting of plants in patches during moisture stress.
Horse gram.treatment_chemical: Seed treatment with Carbendazim 2 g/kg + Thiram 2 g/kg.
Horse gram.treatment_organic: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/kg + application of Farm Yard Manure enriched with Trichoderma..

Horse gram.name: Anthracnose of Horse Gram
Horse gram.symptoms: Depressed circular brown spots with red borders on leaves and pods.
Horse gram.treatment_chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2 g/L or Carbendazim @ 1 g/L..
Horse gram.treatment_organic: Foliar spray of 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE)..

Cowpea.name: Aphid-borne Cowpea Mosaic Virus
Cowpea.symptoms: Severe leaf puckering, dark green blistering and downward curling of margins with chlorotic mottle..
Cowpea.treatment_chemical: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3 ml/L or Thiamethoxam @ 0.3 g/L to control aphid vector..
Cowpea.treatment_organic: Spray Neem oil (3 ml/L) mixed with soft soap solution.

Cowpea.name: Cercospora Leaf Spot of Cowpea
Cowpea.symptoms: Large red-brown angular to circular spots on foliage causing extensive blight and premature leaf drop..
Cowpea.treatment_chemical: Foliar spray of Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP @ 2 g/L..
Cowpea.treatment_organic: Spray Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L with sticker..

Field bean (Avare).name: Avare Anthracnose and Pod Blight
Field bean (Avare).name_kn: ಅವರೆ ಕಾಯಿ ಕೊಳೆತ ಮತ್ತು ಚುಕ್ಕೆ ರೋಗ
Field bean (Avare).name_hi: सेम (अवारे) का एंथ्रेक्नोज व फली सड़न
Field bean (Avare).symptoms: Dark sunken water-soaked circular lesions on green pods filled with pink spore droplets.
Field bean (Avare).treatment_chemical: Spray Carbendazim @ 1 g/L or Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.5 ml/L at flower initiation and pod set..
Field bean (Avare).treatment_organic: Foliar spray of 1% Bordeaux mixture or 5% NSKE..

Field bean (Avare).name: Rust of Field Bean
Field bean (Avare).symptoms: Small brownish-red powdery pustules on underside of leaves surrounded by a yellow halo..
Field bean (Avare).treatment_chemical: Spray Wettable Sulphur @ 3 g/L or Propiconazole @ 1 ml/L..
Field bean (Avare).treatment_organic: Foliar spray of sour buttermilk (5%) + Neem oil (3 ml/L)..

Sunflower.name: Alternaria Leaf Blight
Sunflower.symptoms: Dark brown circular spots with concentric rings on leaves and capitulum.
Sunflower.treatment_chemical: Foliar spray with Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L or Iprodione 50 WP @ 2 g/L at 30, 45, and 60 days..
Sunflower.treatment_organic: Seed treatment with Trichoderma harzianum @ 10 g/kg + foliar spray of NSKE (5%)..

Sunflower.name: Rhizopus Head Rot
Sunflower.symptoms: Soft, water-soaked brown rot on the back of flower heads, followed by coarse black fungal whiskers.
Sunflower.treatment_chemical: Spray Mancozeb @ 2 g/L or Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/L directly onto the back of flower heads..
Sunflower.treatment_organic: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture on flower heads during rainy weather..

Soybean.name: Asian Soybean Rust
Soybean.symptoms: Tiny tan to reddish-brown lesions with volcanic raised pustules on the underside of foliage causing rapid leaf drop..
Soybean.treatment_chemical: Spray Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 1 ml/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L at first appearance..
Soybean.treatment_organic: Spray cow urine (10%) or Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/L..

Soybean.name: Charcoal Rot of Soybean
Soybean.symptoms: Premature drying of leaves which remain attached to the plant.
Soybean.treatment_chemical: Seed treatment with Carboxin + Thiram @ 2 g/kg.
Soybean.treatment_organic: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/kg + farmyard manure enrichment..

Sesame.name: Sesame Phyllody Disease
Sesame.symptoms: Floral parts are transformed into leafy green malformed structures.
Sesame.treatment_chemical: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.7 ml/L or Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3 ml/L to kill leafhoppers..

Sesame.name: Alternaria Leaf Blight of Sesame
Sesame.symptoms: Dark brown to black angular zonate spots on leaves and capsule pods.
Sesame.treatment_chemical: Foliar spray of Mancozeb @ 2 g/L or Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/L..

Safflower.name: Safflower Alternaria Leaf Blight
Safflower.symptoms: Small brown circular spots with concentric rings appearing first on lower leaves and spreading upward to bracts..
Safflower.treatment_chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L or Tebuconazole @ 1 ml/L at rosette and pre-flowering stages..
Safflower.treatment_organic: Foliar spray with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L or 5% Neem oil..

Safflower.name: Fusarium Wilt of Safflower
Safflower.symptoms: Yellowing of leaves on one side of the plant, followed by wilting and vascular browning inside taproot..
Safflower.treatment_organic: Soil application of Trichoderma viride @ 2.5 kg/acre in compost..

Castor.name: Fusarium Wilt of Castor
Castor.symptoms: Dull green foliage, drooping of leaves, interveinal necrosis and blackened vascular strands in the root and lower stem..
Castor.treatment_chemical: Seed treatment with Thiram + Carbendazim (1:1) @ 3 g/kg seed.
Castor.treatment_organic: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/kg + 2.5 kg/acre in 500 kg FYM..

Castor.name: Castor Seedling Blight / Root Rot
Castor.name_hi: अरंडी का पौध झुलसा व जड़ सड़न
Castor.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on cotyledons and collar region causing rapid damp-off and rotting of seedlings..
Castor.treatment_chemical: Drench collar region with Metalaxyl MZ @ 2 g/L or Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/L..
Castor.treatment_organic: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/kg..

Niger.name: Alternaria Leaf Blight of Niger
Niger.symptoms: Small brown spots with concentric target-rings on leaves and flower heads, resulting in poor seed formation..
Niger.treatment_chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L at early vegetative stage..
Niger.treatment_organic: Foliar spray with 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE)..

Niger.name: Powdery Mildew of Niger
Niger.symptoms: White talcum-like powdery coating over upper leaf surface and bracts leading to withered foliage..
Niger.treatment_chemical: Spray Wettable Sulphur 80 WP @ 3 g/L or Hexaconazole @ 1 ml/L..
Niger.treatment_organic: Spray 10% cow urine or 0.5% baking soda solution..

Tobacco (FCV).name: Black Shank Disease
Tobacco (FCV).symptoms: Blackening of the stem base near the soil line extending upward.
Tobacco (FCV).treatment_chemical: Drench nurseries and transplant pits with Metalaxyl MZ @ 2 g/L or Bordeaux mixture 1%..
Tobacco (FCV).treatment_organic: Seedbed application of Trichoderma viride @ 50 g/m²..

Tobacco (FCV).name: Tobacco Mosaic Virus (TMV)
Tobacco (FCV).symptoms: Mottling with light green and dark green blisters on leaf blades, leaf curling, and stunted growth..
Tobacco (FCV).treatment_chemical: No direct chemical cure for virus.
Tobacco (FCV).treatment_organic: Spray skimmed milk solution (100 ml/L) on seedlings before transplanting..

Mulberry (silk).name: Powdery Mildew of Mulberry
Mulberry (silk).symptoms: White floury patches on the lower leaf surface.
Mulberry (silk).treatment_chemical: Foliar spray with Wettable Sulphur @ 2 g/L or Dinocap @ 1 ml/L.
Mulberry (silk).treatment_organic: Spray aqueous extract of Garlic (5%) or Neem oil (3 ml/L)..

Mulberry (silk).name: Mulberry Root Rot Disease
Mulberry (silk).symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of shoots, decay of bark on roots with dark black discoloration.
Mulberry (silk).treatment_chemical: Drench root zones with Carbendazim @ 2 g/L or Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/L..
Mulberry (silk).treatment_organic: Apply 10 kg Trichoderma-enriched organic compost per trench around mulberry stumps..

Potato.name: Late Blight of Potato
Potato.name_hi: आलू का पिछेती झुलसा (लेट ब्लाइट) रोग
Potato.symptoms: Water-soaked dark purplish-brown lesions on leaves and stems with white moldy down beneath during damp weather.
Potato.treatment_chemical: Spray Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Curzate) @ 2.5 g/L or Dimethomorph @ 1 g/L at first appearance..
Potato.treatment_organic: Prophylactic spray of 1% Bordeaux mixture or Copper Hydroxide @ 2 g/L..

Potato.name: Early Blight of Potato
Potato.name_hi: आलू का अगेती झुलसा (अर्ली ब्लाइट) रोग
Potato.symptoms: Brown target-board concentric ring spots on older leaves.
Potato.treatment_chemical: Foliar spray with Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L or Chlorothalonil @ 2 g/L..
Potato.treatment_organic: Foliar spray with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L..

Brinjal.name: Phomopsis Blight and Fruit Rot
Brinjal.name_kn: ಬದನೆ ಕಾಯಿ ಕೊಳೆತ ಮತ್ತು ಎಲೆ ಕರಕಲು ರೋಗ
Brinjal.name_hi: बैंगन का फोमोप्सिस झुलसा व फल सड़न
Brinjal.symptoms: Circular brown leaf spots. Fruits develop soft sunken watery spots covered with black pycnidia, turning into mummified rots..
Brinjal.treatment_chemical: Spray Carbendazim @ 1 g/L or Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/L at 15-day intervals during flowering and fruiting..
Brinjal.treatment_organic: Spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or Trichoderma @ 5 g/L..

Brinjal.name: Bacterial Wilt of Brinjal
Brinjal.symptoms: Rapid daytime wilting while foliage remains green.
Brinjal.treatment_chemical: Root drenching with Streptocycline @ 0.2 g/L + Copper Oxychloride @ 2 g/L..
Brinjal.treatment_organic: Soil application of Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 2.5 kg/acre mixed in FYM at transplanting..

Okra (Bhendi).name: Yellow Vein Mosaic Virus (YVMV)
Okra (Bhendi).name_hi: भिंडी का पीली शिरा मोज़ेक वायरस रोग
Okra (Bhendi).symptoms: Clearing of veins followed by a bold yellow network of veins over green leaf tissue.
Okra (Bhendi).treatment_chemical: Control whitefly vectors: Spray Thiamethoxam @ 0.3 g/L or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.3 g/L..

Okra (Bhendi).name: Powdery Mildew of Okra
Okra (Bhendi).symptoms: White floury coating over upper and lower leaf surfaces causing severe leaf scorch and shedding..
Okra (Bhendi).treatment_chemical: Spray Wettable Sulphur 80 WP @ 3 g/L or Dinocap @ 1 ml/L..
Okra (Bhendi).treatment_organic: Foliar spray with cow milk (10%) or wettable bio-sulphur..

Cabbage.name: Black Rot of Cabbage
Cabbage.name_hi: पत्तागोभी का काला सड़न (ब्लैक रॉट) रोग
Cabbage.symptoms: V-shaped yellow lesions with black vein netting along leaf margins.
Cabbage.treatment_chemical: Spray Streptocycline @ 0.2 g/L + Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5 g/L at 10-14 day intervals..
Cabbage.treatment_organic: Seed soaking in hot water at 50°C for 30 minutes + Pseudomonas fluorescens spray @ 5 g/L..

Cabbage.name: Clubroot Disease
Cabbage.symptoms: Daytime wilting with recovery at night. Roots develop huge spindle-shaped club-like galls and swelling..
Cabbage.treatment_chemical: Drench transplanting holes with Carbendazim @ 1 g/L or Flusulfamide @ 1.5 g/L..
Cabbage.treatment_organic: Incorporate agricultural lime @ 2-3 tons/acre to raise soil pH above 7.2 (clubroot thrives in acidic soil)..

Cauliflower.name: Downy Mildew of Cauliflower
Cauliflower.symptoms: Angular yellow chlorotic lesions on upper leaf surface with a delicate purplish-white downy mold underneath.
Cauliflower.treatment_chemical: Spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil MZ) @ 2 g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1 ml/L..
Cauliflower.treatment_organic: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture or Trichoderma harzianum @ 5 g/L..

Cauliflower.name: Damping Off & Wirestem
Cauliflower.name_kn: ಹೂಕೋಸು ಸಸಿ ಕೊಳೆತ ಮತ್ತು ತಂತಿ ಕಾಂಡ ರೋಗ
Cauliflower.name_hi: फूलगोभी का डैम्पिंग ऑफ व वायरस्टेम
Cauliflower.symptoms: Water-soaked girdling of seedling stems at soil level.
Cauliflower.treatment_chemical: Nursery drench with Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/L or Captan @ 2.5 g/L..
Cauliflower.treatment_organic: Seedbed solarization under 25-micron polythene for 30 days + Trichoderma enrichment..

Carrot.name: Alternaria Leaf Blight of Carrot
Carrot.symptoms: Dark brown-black spots with yellow halos on leaf margins.
Carrot.treatment_chemical: Foliar spray with Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L or Difenoconazole @ 0.5 ml/L..
Carrot.treatment_organic: Spray 5% NSKE or Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L..

Carrot.name: Powdery Mildew of Carrot
Carrot.symptoms: White powdery growth starting on older leaves and petioles spreading across the whole canopy..
Carrot.treatment_chemical: Spray Wettable Sulphur @ 2.5 g/L or Hexaconazole @ 1 ml/L..
Carrot.treatment_organic: Spray bio-sulfur or diluted cow urine (1:10)..

Beetroot.name: Cercospora Leaf Spot of Beetroot
Beetroot.symptoms: Circular spots with ash-grey centers and reddish-purple borders.
Beetroot.treatment_chemical: Spray Mancozeb @ 2 g/L or Carbendazim @ 1 g/L at first appearance of spots..
Beetroot.treatment_organic: Spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or Copper Hydroxide @ 2 g/L..

Beetroot.name: Root Rot / Damping-off
Beetroot.name_kn: ಬೀಟ್ರೂಟ್ ಬೇರು ಮತ್ತು ಗಡ್ಡೆ ಕೊಳೆತ ರೋಗ
Beetroot.symptoms: Sunken dark brown cankers on beet roots near the soil line with soft rotting of crown tissue..
Beetroot.treatment_chemical: Drench soil around plants with Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/L..
Beetroot.treatment_organic: Apply Trichoderma viride enriched FYM @ 2 tons/acre during land preparation..

French beans.name: Bean Anthracnose
French beans.name_kn: ಬೀನ್ಸ್ ಆಂಥ್ರಾಕ್ನೋಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಯಿ ಚುಕ್ಕೆ ರೋಗ
French beans.symptoms: Deep sunken circular lesions with reddish-brown margins on green pods.
French beans.treatment_chemical: Spray Carbendazim 50 WP @ 1 g/L or Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L at 10-day intervals during flowering and pod development..
French beans.treatment_organic: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture or Trichoderma @ 5 g/L..

French beans.name: Bean Rust
French beans.symptoms: Reddish-brown powdery pustules on both leaf surfaces surrounded by chlorotic yellow halos..
French beans.treatment_chemical: Spray Wettable Sulphur @ 3 g/L or Hexaconazole @ 1 ml/L..
French beans.treatment_organic: Spray sour buttermilk (5%) or Neem oil (3 ml/L)..

Cucumber.name: Downy Mildew of Cucumber
Cucumber.symptoms: Angular yellow chlorotic lesions bound by leaf veins on upper leaf surface with purplish-gray downy mold underneath..
Cucumber.treatment_chemical: Spray Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Dimethomorph @ 1 g/L..
Cucumber.treatment_organic: Foliar spray of 1% Bordeaux mixture or Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/L..

Cucumber.name: Powdery Mildew of Cucumber
Cucumber.symptoms: White powdery fungal growth spreading across upper leaf surfaces and stems, causing premature vine collapse..
Cucumber.treatment_chemical: Spray Dinocap @ 1 ml/L or Penconazole 10% EC @ 0.5 ml/L..
Cucumber.treatment_organic: Spray milk-water solution (1:9) or wettable sulphur bio-agent..

Pumpkin.name: Gummy Stem Blight of Pumpkin
Pumpkin.name_hi: कद्दू का गमी स्टेम ब्लाइट रोग
Pumpkin.symptoms: Circular brown leaf spots. Stems develop water-soaked lesions that exude an amber-brown gummy fluid..
Pumpkin.treatment_chemical: Spray Chlorothalonil 75 WP @ 2 g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1 ml/L..

Pumpkin.name: Downy Mildew of Pumpkin
Pumpkin.symptoms: Angular bright yellow spots on leaves with downy purplish-gray mold underneath..

Bottle gourd.name: Anthracnose of Bottle Gourd
Bottle gourd.name_hi: लौकी का एंथ्रेक्नोज व फल सड़न
Bottle gourd.symptoms: Circular water-soaked sunken lesions on fruits with gelatinous salmon-pink spore droplets.
Bottle gourd.treatment_chemical: Foliar spray with Carbendazim @ 1 g/L or Mancozeb @ 2 g/L at 12-day intervals..
Bottle gourd.treatment_organic: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture or Trichoderma @ 5 g/L..

Bottle gourd.name: Cucumber Mosaic Virus on Bottle Gourd
Bottle gourd.symptoms: Mosaic mottling, leaf distortion, blister-like puckering and malformed warty fruits..
Bottle gourd.treatment_chemical: Spray Imidacloprid @ 0.3 ml/L or Dimethoate @ 1.7 ml/L to control aphid vectors..

Drumstick.name: Drumstick Fruit Rot / Pod Rot
Drumstick.symptoms: Pods rot from tip upwards with brown discoloration, weeping exudate and internal seed blackening..
Drumstick.treatment_chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L or Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/L at pod initiation..
Drumstick.treatment_organic: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture or 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE)..

Drumstick.name: Twig Canker and Die-Back
Drumstick.name_hi: सहजन का टहनी सूखा व कैंकर रोग
Drumstick.symptoms: Drying and die-back of terminal twigs progressing downward.
Drumstick.treatment_chemical: Prune dried twigs 5 cm below infection and apply Bordeaux paste on cut surfaces..
Drumstick.treatment_organic: Apply cow dung-neem paste on pruned limb stubs..

Mango.name: Mango Anthracnose
Mango.name_kn: ಮಾವಿನ ಆಂಥ್ರಾಕ್ನೋಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕಪ್ಪು ಚುಕ್ಕೆ ರೋಗ
Mango.name_hi: आम का एंथ्रेक्नोज व काला धब्बा रोग
Mango.symptoms: Black tear-staining spots on fruits, blossom blight on panicles causing flower drop, and leaf anthracnose spots..
Mango.treatment_chemical: Spray Carbendazim @ 1 g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1 ml/L at panicle emergence and fruit marble stage..
Mango.treatment_organic: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture before flowering and after fruit harvest..

Mango.name: Powdery Mildew of Mango
Mango.symptoms: White powdery fungal bloom covering inflorescence panicles, flowers, and tiny fruitlets causing massive fruit drop..
Mango.treatment_chemical: Spray Wettable Sulphur 80 WP @ 3 g/L or Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 1 ml/L at bud burst and full bloom..
Mango.treatment_organic: Foliar spray with bio-sulfur or Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L..

Papaya.name: Papaya Ring Spot Virus (PRSV)
Papaya.name_hi: पपीते का रिंग स्पॉट वायरस रोग
Papaya.symptoms: Yellow mosaic mottle on leaves, shoe-stringing of leaf blades, oily dark green streaks on petioles and concentric ring spots on green fruits..
Papaya.treatment_chemical: Spray Imidacloprid @ 0.3 ml/L or Thiamethoxam @ 0.3 g/L to manage aphid vector populations..
Papaya.treatment_organic: Erect barrier crops of 3 rows of Maize or Sorghum around the papaya plot.

Papaya.name: Papaya Collar Rot / Foot Rot
Papaya.symptoms: Water-soaked spongy lesions at the stem base near the soil line.
Papaya.treatment_chemical: Drench trunk base and basin with Metalaxyl MZ @ 2 g/L or Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/L..
Papaya.treatment_organic: Apply Trichoderma viride (50 g/tree) mixed with neem cake in the root basin..

Sapota (Chikku).name: Phaeophleospora Leaf Spot of Sapota
Sapota (Chikku).symptoms: Numerous circular red-brown spots with whitish centers on leaves causing heavy premature leaf defoliation and small fruits..
Sapota (Chikku).treatment_chemical: Spray Mancozeb @ 2 g/L or Carbendazim @ 1 g/L at monthly intervals during the monsoon..
Sapota (Chikku).treatment_organic: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture or 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE)..

Sapota (Chikku).name: Sooty Mold of Sapota
Sapota (Chikku).name_hi: चीकू का काली फफूंद (सूटी मोल्ड) रोग
Sapota (Chikku).symptoms: Thick black velvety soot covering upper leaf surfaces and fruit skins, hampering photosynthesis..
Sapota (Chikku).treatment_chemical: Spray Starch solution (2%) or wettable sulphur @ 3 g/L + Chlorpyriphos @ 2 ml/L to kill scale insects..
Sapota (Chikku).treatment_organic: Spray Fish Oil Rosin Soap (25 g/L) to wash off scale insects and sooty crust..

Guava.name: Guava Wilt Disease
Guava.symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of twigs from one side, premature leaf shedding, bark splitting, and complete drying of the tree within months..
Guava.treatment_chemical: Soil drenching around root zone with Carbendazim @ 2 g/L or Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/L..
Guava.treatment_organic: Incorporate Trichoderma harzianum @ 50 g + Neem cake @ 2 kg per tree basin twice annually..

Guava.name: Guava Anthracnose and Canker
Guava.name_kn: ಸೀಬೆ ಕಾಯಿ ಚುಕ್ಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಳೆತ ರೋಗ
Guava.name_hi: अमरूद का एंथ्रेक्नोज व फल कैंकर
Guava.symptoms: Raised circular crater-like corky cankers on fruit skin with cracking.
Guava.treatment_chemical: Spray Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/L or Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L at 15-day intervals during fruit set..
Guava.treatment_organic: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture after pruning and before flowering..

Watermelon.name: Fusarium Wilt of Watermelon
Watermelon.symptoms: Sudden wilting of individual vine runners during warm afternoons.
Watermelon.treatment_chemical: Drench basin with Carbendazim @ 1 g/L or Thiophanate Methyl @ 1 g/L..
Watermelon.treatment_organic: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/kg + soil incorporation with FYM..

Watermelon.name: Gummy Stem Blight of Watermelon
Watermelon.symptoms: Circular brown leaf lesions. Stem develops water-soaked cankers oozing reddish-brown gum..
Watermelon.treatment_chemical: Spray Chlorothalonil 75 WP @ 2 g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1 ml/L..
Watermelon.treatment_organic: Foliar spray with Copper Hydroxide @ 2 g/L..

Black pepper.name: Quick Wilt / Foot Rot of Black Pepper
Black pepper.name_hi: काली मिर्च का त्वरित उकठा (फुट रॉट) रोग
Black pepper.symptoms: Rapid wilting and shedding of all leaves, spikes and lateral branches within a few days.
Black pepper.treatment_chemical: Drench vine basins with Potassium Phosphonate (Akomin) @ 3 ml/L or Metalaxyl MZ @ 2 g/L in June and August..
Black pepper.treatment_organic: Apply Trichoderma harzianum @ 50 g mixed in 5 kg FYM + Neem cake to each vine collar..

Black pepper.name: Pollu Disease / Anthracnose
Black pepper.name_hi: काली मिर्च का पोल्लू / एंथ्रेक्नोज रोग
Black pepper.symptoms: Brown circular spots on leaves and berries. Infected berries turn hollow, light, and black (Pollu berries)..
Black pepper.treatment_chemical: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture or Carbendazim @ 1 g/L in June-July and September..
Black pepper.treatment_organic: Spray Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L with sticker..

Cardamom.name: Capsule Rot / Azhukal Disease
Cardamom.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on young capsules which rot and detach easily.
Cardamom.treatment_chemical: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture on leaves and drench panicles with Potassium Phosphonate @ 3 ml/L prior to monsoon onset..
Cardamom.treatment_organic: Soil application of Trichoderma viride @ 50 g + 2 kg neem cake per clump..

Cardamom.name: Katte / Mosaic Disease of Cardamom
Cardamom.name_hi: इलायची का कट्टे / मोज़ेक वायरस रोग
Cardamom.symptoms: Discontinuous chlorotic stripes on young emerging leaves.
Cardamom.treatment_chemical: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.7 ml/L to manage aphid vector colonies on pseudostems..
Cardamom.treatment_organic: Spray Neem oil (3 ml/L) with soap solution..

Turmeric.name: Rhizome Rot / Soft Rot of Turmeric
Turmeric.name_hi: हल्दी का कंद सड़न (प्रकंद विगलन) रोग
Turmeric.symptoms: Yellowing of leaves from margins inward. Pseudostem collar becomes soft and easily pulls out with rotten, foul-smelling rhizomes..
Turmeric.treatment_chemical: Rhizome treatment with Metalaxyl MZ @ 2 g/L before planting.
Turmeric.treatment_organic: Rhizome dip in Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/L + application of 2 tons neem-enriched FYM per acre..

Turmeric.name: Leaf Blotch of Turmeric
Turmeric.name_hi: हल्दी का पर्ण धब्बा (लीफ ब्लॉच) रोग
Turmeric.symptoms: Small oval reddish-brown to yellow spots on both leaf surfaces which coalesce into large brown patches..
Turmeric.treatment_chemical: Spray Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L or Propiconazole @ 1 ml/L at first symptom detection..
Turmeric.treatment_organic: Foliar spray of 1% Bordeaux mixture or Pseudomonas @ 5 g/L..

Ginger.name: Soft Rot / Rhizome Rot of Ginger
Ginger.name_kn: ಶುಂಠಿ ಬೆಂಕಿ ರೋಗ / ಗಡ್ಡೆ ಕೊಳೆತ ರೋಗ
Ginger.name_hi: अदरक का प्रकंद सड़न (सॉफ्ट रॉट) रोग
Ginger.symptoms: Water-soaking at the collar region of pseudostems, lower leaves turn yellow and wither.
Ginger.treatment_chemical: Treat seed rhizomes with Metalaxyl MZ @ 2 g/L.
Ginger.treatment_organic: Treat rhizomes with Trichoderma harzianum @ 10 g/L for 30 minutes.

Ginger.name: Bacterial Wilt of Ginger
Ginger.symptoms: Rapid bronzing and downward rolling of leaf margins followed by sudden wilting.
Ginger.treatment_chemical: Soil drenching with Streptocycline @ 0.2 g/L + Copper Oxychloride @ 2 g/L..
Ginger.treatment_organic: Incorporate Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 kg/acre in well-decomposed FYM at planting..

Cashew.name: Die-Back / Pink Disease of Cashew
Cashew.name_hi: काजू का टहनी सूखा (डाई-बैक) व पिंक रोग
Cashew.treatment_chemical: Prune infected branches 10 cm below infection and swab cuts with Bordeaux paste (10%).
Cashew.treatment_organic: Apply cow dung + copper sulfate paste on pruning cuts..

Cashew.name: Cashew Anthracnose
Cashew.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on young flushes, inflorescence panicles and nuts, turning into reddish-brown sunken cankers..
Cashew.treatment_chemical: Foliar spray with Carbendazim @ 1 g/L or Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L during new vegetative flush..
Cashew.treatment_organic: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture or Neem extract (5%)..

Marigold.name: Alternaria Leaf Spot and Flower Blight
Marigold.name_kn: ಚೆಂಡುಹೂವು ಆಲ್ಟರ್ನೇರಿಯಾ ಎಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹೂ ಕರಕಲು ರೋಗ
Marigold.name_hi: गेंदे का अल्टरनेरिया पत्ती व फूल झुलसा
Marigold.symptoms: Circular brownish-black spots on leaves. Flower buds turn black and fail to open; mature petals turn soggy brown and rot..
Marigold.treatment_chemical: Foliar spray with Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2 g/L or Iprodione @ 2 g/L at 10-day intervals from bud formation..
Marigold.treatment_organic: Foliar spray of 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/L..

Marigold.name: Collar Rot and Root Rot of Marigold
Marigold.name_hi: गेंदे का कॉलर रॉट व जड़ सड़न
Marigold.symptoms: Blackening and water-soaked rotting of the stem base near the soil line causing sudden collapse and wilting of plants..
Marigold.treatment_chemical: Soil drenching around plants with Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/L or Metalaxyl MZ @ 2 g/L..
Marigold.treatment_organic: Drench with Trichoderma harzianum @ 10 g/L + application of bio-enriched vermicompost..
